notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list mentions this entry, with coordinates, elevation (feet inferred, units not stated on the list) and a 'datasheet' tag. The story gives 310 unitless and says that if it is feet it is about 94.5 m. The list does not explain what 'old' means, and no source says whether it is an earlier tower on the same site as the Swainsboro entry 1.5 km away. The 1.5 km and under-a-mile distances are our calculation from the two listed coordinate pairs, not a figure the list gives. The 'datasheet' tag may point to the NGS datasheet lookup, which was not searched and may describe a survey mark at the site; the story only says the list links to an NGS lookup and does not expand NGS, which the page does not spell out. No build date, staffing, fires or fate found. Story body is about 145 words, above the 120-word guideline, even though the evidence is thin.
